lines.en: It was a good night for Chika Chosokabe.

She was taking either a step forward or backward depending on your motivations for being here and, for the first moment since her tongue departed her good friend’s clitoris, she was actually kind of happy.

She wasn’t happy in the sense that things were going well, though. Just that they weren’t getting any worse. And that they probably couldn’t get any worse unless her boyfriend started fucking her little sister too.
It was a possibility, she thought. She hadn’t forgotten the time he brought her name up during discussions of a potential threesome, despite how much she wanted to.
That would be rock bottom, though. She’d probably just die if things ever came to that. But things would obviously never come to that because she had just solved everything!
She’d managed to confront him and partially explain her stance and mindset in a mostly mature way, reminiscent of the way she used to be before the worm of Giles Corey began to eat away at her brain.
But it all felt too easy. It all felt too simple. Which meant it all felt so wrong.

This wasn’t the type of issue that could be solved in a single talk on the way home from work. This would require tears. Pain. Memories of hints that sneak in before late night panic attacks in the bathroom.
She was far too coherent for any of it to feel real.
Which, in turn, led to her questioning just how much of what she knew was actually fake.
: Chinami! I’m home!
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
Oh, good. She wasn’t being fucked.
But she was being different.
What a silly girl she was — always using her femur to bash the dinner bell. Idling like the bed of Jesus as she gazes out the window, dreaming of peanuts and pancakes.
: What are you doing, weirdo? Come give me a hug.
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
: Uh...yeah. Big sis Chika missed you too. And guess what? She ran into Papa on the way home. And she thinks she’s going to start trying to act a little more like her old self again so-
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
: Chinami?
: Are you okay?
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
: Yes. Chinami has said that many times now. Which means Chika is worried Chinami is sleepwalking again.
She used her hand to shoulder. An act of reassurance. The kind that Mom would bake.
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
But when that shoulderbird don’t sing, we’re left to question how to make-
: Chinami...come on. Stop acting weird.
Coffee in each glorious way — each melodious aroma misconstrued.
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
With the creaking of seventh step, you’ll see what I am to you.
: Chinami. Wake up. You’re doing it again.
: The one who really needs to wake up is you!
: Huh?! Who’s there?! What are you doing in my-
: Chika Chosokabe — your attendance is required for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium in nineteen years, eleven days, six hours, and fourty-four minutes.
: The current temperature is a sweltering ninety-seven degrees Fahrenheit. You may experience difficulties using certain outdated technology due to the heat.
: The time of day is somewhere between 2:00 PM and 4:30 PM. The exact time is not currently able to be confirmed. We apologize for the inconvenience.
: To show you how sorry we are, we cordially invite you to the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event. Please speak to your guide in order to request more information.
: A...dream?...
: What?...
: Hello?...
: Everyone is right. I am going insane.
: Why would God...give me a gift?
: I’ve never been special at all.
: I’ve done nothing to deserve this.
: Am I supposed to do something?...
: What do you mean?...
: Excuse me?...
She approaches the cube, which remains perfectly still. The way it always has. The way it always will.
She gazes into its depths, uncovering secrets of the earth’s formation. Every way to brew coffee. How to make yourself look even more beautiful for the person you love.
There are so many answers packed inside that she can’t figure out what to ask.
So she defaults to what an earlier voice told her.
: I’d like to know more about the Summer Blast Savings event at Spacy’s.
She reaches out toward the cube.
She feels like she has to.
It’s what everyone else in her grade is doing.
Success.
Finally, something.
After being sucked into the cube, Chika Chosokabe awakens with a renewed sense of self — directly in front of the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event.
And what she sees before her is nothing short of the most exciting thing in any context that she has ever seen.
Lovers! As far as the eye can reach with its fingers! So long as they’re nearsighted eyes that can’t escape the grips of the Great [[REDACTED] Mall.
As the pungent stenches of sex and body odor assault her senses, however, she can do little more than stand there in shock.
So many penises! So many vaginas! So much moaning and groaning, turning and churning!
But while her heart’s quickly burning, she’s suddenly learning that she hasn’t been crazy at all!
One more misbegotten beguiling for the pile, she smiles — scribbling neatly of self-deceit on the back of a treat receipt before begrudgingly smudging her words in defeat. That cheat!
He had swooned her! Groomed her! Touched her from her head to her feet! Yet he’s been out on the street, calling others his sweet, while she slaved over a stove so her sister could eat?!

No! Unacceptable! But sad. So sad. She was so very, sad. She knew he meant no wrong! Sex is like bowling for adults. She just needed to get better at it. And she was in just the right place to do that.

She probably wouldn’t though, seeing as the only thing keeping her from vomiting in her mouth at the idea of someone else entering it was the fact that she had never seen so many dicks at the same time before.
: Thank you for attending the annual Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event. The sale is now complete.
: Please exit the store and find a partner for the dance as soon as possible. Refreshments will be provided for those in need of a break.
: What the fuck is happening right now?
: It’s the...Spacy’s...Summer Blast...Savings event! It’s the best...aah...orgy...of the year!
: I’ve...gotten...nine different girls...pregnant today! My wife...is going to be...so proud! She’s always...wanted kids!
: If you...still need a partner...you can...join me! I’m almost...done with...this one!
: Noooo! I want more! Stay with me! I need it! I need more cuuuuuum!
: (Very loud sex noises)
: No...No...Sex isn’t...supposed to be like this! It’s...something you do...with...someone...someone you...
: MAY I HAVE THIS DANCE?
: What?! Huh?! Who the...what the fuck are you?!
: LONELY...
: SAME...AS YOU...
: I...I have a boyfriend! I-I-I don’t “dance” with just anyone. Especially not creepy fucking monster things. Not even in my dreams. Sorry. Bye.
: NO ONE...SINGLE HERE...
: ALL...WANT...FUCK...
: Absolutely not. Leave. Now. Go.
: EVERYBODY’S DOING IT...
: WHY MATTER IF NOT LOVE?...
: Because I’m not going make myself vulnerable for some...thing that probably wants to eat me!
: YOU FUCK...HUMAN? ONLY?
: Yes. Human only. Boyfriend only. His name “Sensei.” I fuck him. He not here.
: YOU HERE.
: Yes. I’m here.
: IF YOU HERE...YOU WANT FUCK...
: No. For the last time, I-
: Ah! Big sis Chika!
: Chinami didn’t know you were coming to the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event!
: C-Chinami?! What are you doing here?! Get away from that thing right now!
: Chinami loves the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event! She comes every year! There are so many nice ojii-sans who always give her tons of treats! All she needs to do is make them feel good.
: Chinami...does what?
: Who’s that, big sis Chika? Is that your dance partner? I haven’t seen him here before!
: H...HELLO...PRETTY GIRL...
: He’s not my partner, Chinami! I’m in love with your papa, remember?! Good girls are only supposed to have one partner! Now please let go of that thing and come here!
: That’s no good, big sis Chika! Everyone helps everyone at the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event! So it’s our job to make all of the ojii-sans feel good!
: Chinami!
: What’s wrong? Everybody’s doing it.
: WANT...TOUCH...PRETTY GIRL...
: Okay! Chinami will help two ojii-sans at once today! And she’s super experienced, so she’ll help you both feel reeeeeeally good!
: No. Stop. I will do it. I will dance with the faceless ones. All of them.
: I will do whatever it takes to protect my sister.
: Aww, big sis Chika loves Chinami so much! But Chinami isn’t in any danger, so there is no need to protect her at all!
: Maybe Chinami and big sis Chika can help our ojii-sans together?
: Yes. That is a good idea, Chinami.
: Everybody’s doing it.
: FUCK...TWO PRETTY GIRLS...ONE TIME...
: THIS...HEAVEN...YES?
: Yes.
: This is Heaven.
: Chinami!
: I’m home.
